svg.title: Pathways Studio — S3B
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the S3B shared-palette logo. Navy serif lettering with a teal route extending from the y and a magenta circular endpoint. All lettering is outlined; no fonts or raster images are required. Transparent background and transparent endpoint center. The approved raster silhouette is traced and colors are flattened to navy #0A1330, teal #3FA8A8, and magenta #EE2A7B.
